field_review.category_and_near_duplicate: Order, ID, source path/index, and category match. Recomputed source and keeper object hashes match their freeze values. field_review.cause_and_physical_actions: A liner barely stretched over the bin rim is pulled down by a bowl of wet leftovers; the liner edge flips inward, leaving a gap for liquid and scraps to leak into the bin. The narrator hooks the liner edge; as it slips inward again, holding the rim steady while pulling the liner back up is physically plausible. Clips secure the liner mouth to the rim; with a full load, lifting the bag pops the clips and lets the liner slip back, dropping leaves. After cleanup, a new liner is passed over the rim and folded outward, then clipped; pouring in another bowl tests the setup and it stays seated. The sequence of failure, cleanup, adjustment, and retry is coherent.

The expressions for a small-size bag, leftovers, bin rim, clip failure, folding outward, and testing with another bowl are understandable in context.
